ideas.pitch: An IoT-based automated power conservation system using provided sensor kits and microcontrollers to monitor and cut off idle classroom electricity.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Energy Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the provided on-campus hardware and sensor kits directly, offering a tangible physical build that stands out in a room of standard web applications.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision safety assistant that flags students in the school innovation lab who are not wearing safety goggles or handling equipment incorrectly.
ideas.title: LabSafety Vision Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses school innovation lab usage, aligning well with the university's focus on on-campus hardware and laboratory equipment safety.

ideas.pitch: An automated waste segregation prototype utilizing a microcontroller, camera module, and servo motors to instantly classify and sort biodegradable and non-biodegradable trash.
ideas.title: EcoSort Autonomous Bin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware components and sensors provided by the college with a live, working physical demonstration that appeals strongly to school judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized student support and curriculum roadmap generator tailored specifically for high school board exam preparation in Classes 9 through 12.
ideas.title: StudyPath AI Mentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact age demographic of the hackathon participants (Classes 9-12), making the problem and solution deeply relatable to the judges and students.

ideas.pitch: An automated micro-irrigation prototype built with soil moisture sensors, a relay circuit, and a microcontroller to manage school garden watering efficiently.
ideas.title: Smart Plant Hydration System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses physical sensor kits provided on-campus to solve a real school maintenance problem with a reliable working live demo.
